opportunities.title: AI Luxury Jewelry Showcase Videos
opportunities.description: AI Video Creator – Luxury Jewelry Brand (AI-Generated Videos & UGC) - Video & Animation You have already been hired on this job. View We are looking for a skilled AI Video Creator to produce hyper-realistic, cinematic, and high-end luxury video content for a bespoke fine jewelry brand. Our visual direction is centered around luxury lifestyle, craftsmanship, and storytelling. Think cinematic scenes of people wearing fine jewelry, jewelry-making processes, artisan craftsmanship, and elegant lifestyle moments. What You'll Do Create hyper-realistic AI-generated videos using tools such as Kling, Nano Banana, Seedance, Google Veo, or other comparable AI creation tools. Utilise existing product assets, including 3D rendering images, 360° rendering videos, raw craftsmanship footage, and raw packaging footage, to produce cinematic luxury lifestyle videos, jewelry-making scenes, product-focused videos, and realistic AI-generated UGC content. Transform jewelry renders into photorealistic lifestyle scenes featuring people naturally wearing our jewelry. Create realistic AI UGC, including AI models, talking avatars, product demonstrations, and unboxing experiences. Follow creative directions, storyboards, scripts, and shot lists provided by our Content/Creative Director. Combine AI-generated visuals and existing footage into polished Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and advertising creatives, including video editing and post-production. What We're Looking For Proven experience creating high-quality AI-generated videos and AI UGC content. Strong skills in AI image generation, image-to-video generation, and video editing. Strong understanding of luxury aesthetics, cinematic storytelling, lighting, composition, and realistic human movement. Ability to create believable, photorealistic scenes that don't look obviously AI-generated, maintaining visual consistency across scenes. Comfortable collaborating with a Content/Creative Director and following detailed creative instructions. Important :Before Applying: Please apply only if you have demonstrated experience creating hyper-realistic AI videos and AI-generated UGC. All deliverables must be suitable for commercial use. Include the following in your application: 1. Your portfolio or examples of AI-generated videos and AI UGC you've personally created. 2. The AI tools and video editing software you regularly use. 3. Any relevant experience creating luxury, fashion, jewelry, or lifestyle content (not required but is a plus). 4. Your indicative pricing and turnaround time for a 15–30-second video.

opportunities.title: Build Secure Citizen Complaint PWA
opportunities.description: I need a developer to turn my working prototype of a Citizen Complaint Portal (India) into a secure, production-ready web app (mobile-first PWA, Hindi + English). How it works: - Complaints are raised at a local "Chaupal" (held at the polling place, so the unit is a polling booth). - Other residents give consent. Once enough consent is collected, the Chaupal's "Sabhapati" files the complaint to the department in the group's name (so individuals don't have to give their own name) and follows up on progress. - Departments (electricity, water, roads, sanitation, police) get time limits (SLA) with automatic escalation. - A public dashboard shows area-wise and department-wise results. Scope: 1. Backend + database (PostgreSQL preferred) with a generic parent-child area table: State > District > Constituency > Part > Chaupal (names editable, CSV import) 2. Mobile OTP login; roles: Citizen, Sabhapati, Officer, Admin 3. Complaint flow: raise > consent > forward > status updates > rating / reopen 4. SLA + automatic escalation 5. SMS / WhatsApp status updates 6. Photo/video upload 7. Public dashboard and admin panel 8. Audit trail, identity protection, backups, basic security testing 9. Hosting, domain and SSL setup + short documentation I will share the working prototype and a project proposal with shortlisted freelancers. Terms: full ownership of code and design with etc.

opportunities.title: Growth Marketing Manager for Cosmesi Academy
opportunities.description: Freelance Growth & Marketing Manager – Cosmesi Academy We are looking for a proactive, growth-oriented person who can take charge of growing Cosmesi Academy growth- our online platform offering 360+ cosmetic formulation courses. The role involves planning marketing strategies, generating sales, growing our app users and customer base, launching campaigns, and executing ideas from start to finish. We are looking for someone who doesn't just suggest ideas but takes ownership of implementation and results. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute growth strategies to increase course sales and overall revenue. Drive growth of the Cosmesi Academy app, including app downloads, user acquisition, engagement and conversions. Plan and execute marketing campaigns, offers, launches and promotional activities. Develop strategies to convert social media followers, website visitors and app users into paying customers. Manage and execute Instagram, WhatsApp. Meta ads and other marketing channels for sales growth. Plan customer acquisition, retargeting, repeat purchases and customer reactivation campaigns. Identify opportunities to increase average order value through bundles, premium courses, upsells and new offers. Coordinate Meta advertising campaigns and work towards improving ROAS and customer acquisition. Analyze sales, customer behavior, campaign performance and marketing data. Work on app marketing strategies, retention campaigns, notifications and customer engagement. Take ownership of campaigns from idea generation to execution, tracking and reporting. What We Are Looking For Experience in growth marketing, digital marketing or online business growth. Strong understanding of customer acquisition and sales conversion. Experience with Meta Ads, performance marketing and retargeting. Knowledge of app growth and user acquisition strategies. Ability to plan marketing campaigns and execute them independently. Creative thinking combined with data-driven decision making. Strong execution skills, initiative and accountability. Someone who constantly experiments, identifies growth opportunities and takes action without needing to be micromanaged. Our Goal Cosmesi Academy has a large library of courses, an existing audience, an app and an established customer base. We want to unlock its growth potential, build a stronger sales system, reach new customers and significantly increase monthly revenue. We are looking for someone who can work closely with the founder and take responsibility for making this growth happen. This is a hands-on role. We are looking for a person who can plan, execute, test, optimize and grow - not just provide suggestions or reports. Interested candidates should share their experience, previous work, results achieved, proposed approach and monthly/project fee.

opportunities.title: 3D Animated Children’s Bible Series
opportunities.description: Hello, My name is Michael, and I am an entrepreneur based in South Africa. I am looking for a professional AI animation studio to partner with me in creating a premium-quality animated children’s Bible series, covering the entire Bible from Genesis to Revelation. OUR VISION We want to create a beautiful, entertaining and educational animated Bible series for children aged 4–12, which we intend to distribute and sell internationally. Our preferred animation style is high-quality, Disney/Pixar-inspired 3D animation, featuring expressive characters, beautiful environments, cinematic lighting and engaging storytelling. The animation must be visually consistent, with characters maintaining the same appearance throughout the episodes. EPISODE REQUIREMENTS • Approximately 5–7 minutes per episode. • Biblical stories presented accurately and in an age-appropriate manner. • Characters speaking naturally to one another, supported by professional narration. • High-quality animation, realistic movements and expressive facial features. • Professional voice acting, background music and sound effects. • Full HD or 4K final video quality. • Consistent characters and animation quality across the entire series. We would like to begin with the Book of Genesis, starting with the story of Creation, and gradually work through the entire Bible. LONG-TERM BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY Our intention is to produce a complete series of potentially 100–150 episodes. We plan to begin with a small number of episodes, market and sell them internationally, and reinvest the revenue into producing additional episodes. We are therefore looking for an affordable, reliable, long-term animation partner. COMMERCIAL RIGHTS As this is a commercial project, we require full commercial distribution rights, including the ability to sell downloadable episodes worldwide, use our own branding, and translate or dub the series into multiple languages. Ideally, we would like ownership of the original characters, artwork and completed productions. QUOTATION REQUEST Could you please provide: 1. Your estimated production cost for a complete 5-minute episode. 2. Your pricing for a series of 5, 10 or more episodes. 3. Examples of your highest-quality 3D animated children’s productions. 4. Your estimated production time per episode. 5. Details regarding commercial ownership and distribution rights. 6. Whether you offer a short paid sample before committing to a complete episode. We have an initial production budget and are looking for competitive pricing, as our objective is to establish a sustainable long-term partnership. I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Michael Bruwer South Africa

opportunities.title: Simple YouTube Video Edit
opportunities.description: I have a raw recording that needs to be transformed into a polished YouTube upload. The direction is straightforward: keep the pacing natural, apply clean basic cuts, and trim out every obvious mistake or long pause so the final piece flows smoothly from start to finish. No flashy effects are necessary—just a tidy, professional-looking edit that lets the content shine. You’ll receive the original footage along with any notes or time-stamps I’ve marked. I’d like the finished video delivered in the same resolution as the source (ideally 1080p) plus the editable project file in case tweaks are needed later. Acceptance criteria: • All stumbles, dead air, and retakes are removed • Transitions between cuts feel seamless, with audio kept consistent • Final render delivered as a high-quality MP4 and the corresponding project file If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Modern High-Quality Digital Solution
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a creative expert who can take my vision and turn it into a clean, premium-grade solution that feels effortless to use and impressive to look at. The end product—whether it’s a full site, an application, or another interactive deliverable—must be visually polished, functionally robust, and 100 % ready for real-world deployment on desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile screens. What matters most to me is a thoughtful process: start by clarifying goals and user needs, move into well-organized wireframes, refine them into a modern interface, and finish with a fully working build that includes smart automation wherever it genuinely adds value. I expect meticulous attention to typography, spacing, and hierarchy so the experience feels premium rather than templated, plus concise documentation that lets me hand the project to any stakeholder with confidence. I’ll rely on your guidance at each milestone—from the first concept review through to final QA—so please be prepared to explain options, steer best practices, and keep quality, creativity, and efficiency front and center. If you thrive on producing distinctive, reliable digital work and can walk me through every step toward launch-ready perfection, I’d love to collaborate.

opportunities.title: Meta Ads para Leads de Peluquerías
opportunities.description: Título Especialista en Meta Ads para generar leads de salones de peluquería (B2B) en toda España Descripción Somos una distribuidora de marcas premium de cosmética capilar en España y buscamos a una persona freelance especialista en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) para generar leads de salones de peluquería de toda España (venta B2B). El seguimiento comercial de los leads lo hacemos nosotros. Queremos empezar cuanto antes. Qué harás: Crear y lanzar las campañas de generación de leads (estructura, audiencias y segmentación para toda España). Crear los anuncios: textos y creatividades, con varias versiones para testear. Configurar el formulario de captación (nombre del salón, ciudad, teléfono, correo y marcas que usa). Optimizar y escalar las campañas para conseguir el máximo de leads válidos al menor coste. Enviarnos un informe semanal sencillo (leads, coste por lead y qué anuncios funcionan). Qué es un lead válido: un salón de peluquería interesado en nuestras marcas que rellena el formulario con datos de contacto reales. Qué no incluye: llamar o gestionar los leads ni consultoría de crecimiento. La política de privacidad y el consentimiento del formulario los aportamos nosotros. Condiciones: Inversión publicitaria de prueba de hasta 10.000 €/mes, que pagamos directamente a Meta. Trabajo sobre nuestra cuenta publicitaria, con acceso como colaborador. Tarifa fija mensual durante un periodo de prueba de 3 meses, sin parte variable, con revisión al final del primer mes. Requisitos: Experiencia demostrable en campañas de generación de leads en Meta Ads con presupuestos comparables. Casos con resultados (leads y coste por lead), idealmente B2B o negocios locales. Español de nivel nativo o C1.

opportunities.description: I need a clean, modern-and-simple front elevation for my G+1 residence. The key visual element I want to highlight is a balcony with a glass railing that feels light, minimal, and elegant against the façade. I’m open to subtle texture variations—think muted paint tones or a single accent cladding—so long as the overall look stays simple and modern. Send through a quick outline of your approach, any past examples of similar projects, and your estimated turnaround time, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: n8n AI Chatbot: Web & WhatsApp
opportunities.description: I’m building an AI-powered support assistant orchestrated entirely in n8n. In this first phase the bot must respond on two fronts—our website’s live-chat widget and our WhatsApp number—using the same brain and conversation history regardless of channel. Knowledge base The answers should be generated from: • Content scraped or pulled via API from our public help-center website • A collection of PDFs/manuals I will upload Retrieval, embedding, and prompt-engineering logic can live inside n8n itself or call out to external services (e.g. OpenAI, Pinecone, Supabase, Weaviate); I’m open as long as the workflow remains transparent and editable in n8n. Fallback flow Whenever the model’s confidence drops below an agreed threshold it must hand the dialogue—along with full context—to a human agent. I don’t want the bot asking customers for extra details; it should immediately escalate. Deliverables 1. n8n workflow (export file) covering: ingestion of sources, vector store updates, real-time chat handling for website and WhatsApp, fallback routing. 2. Installation/connection notes for the live-chat widget you choose (if it’s not already native to n8n) and the WhatsApp API (Twilio, 360dialog, or other). 3. Short Loom or markdown walkthrough so my team can extend the flow and add new documents later. Acceptance criteria • Bot answers at least 80 % of a supplied test set correctly within 2 seconds. • Low-confidence queries are routed to the human queue every time, with transcript attached. • Entire solution runs in my self-hosted n8n instance with no proprietary vendor lock-in. If this sounds like a build you can knock out efficiently, let’s talk timelines and any prerequisites you have.

opportunities.title: Vegas Gold 3D Animation
opportunities.description: I need a short, punchy 8–10-second animation built entirely around a Vegas-gold-and-black palette. The sequence should focus on a realistic 3D product or character reveal—think high-end showroom lighting, slick reflections, and a touch of luxury that fits those colors perfectly. I’ll supply a reference clip so you can match pacing and mood; feel free to push the visuals so long as the timing stays tight and the color scheme remains consistent. Final delivery in 4K MOV/MP4 plus the editable project file (Cinema 4D, Blender, or Maya are all fine—use what you’re fastest in). Audio isn’t essential, but a subtle swoosh or whoosh that complements the look would be a welcome bonus. Acceptance criteria • Runtime falls between 8 and 10 seconds • Colors read clearly as Vegas gold (#C5B358–ish) and deep black, no other hues creeping in • Photoreal lighting and materials—no cartoon shading • Smooth playback at 24 fps or 30 fps, no dropped frames • One round of revisions included to tweak timing, reflections, or minor color adjustments If this sounds clear, let me know which tool you prefer and your typical turnaround time so we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Premium Scottsdale Snow Globe Holiday Card
opportunities.description: I need a professional, premium Christmas greeting card design for a corporate client. **Project Concept:** Scottsdale Winter Wonderland Snow Globe. **Dimensions:** 5.50 × 7.50 inches, portrait orientation, 300 DPI, print-ready format. **Main Design:** - A large, realistic glass snow globe as the centerpiece. - Inside the globe, a beautiful snowy Scottsdale town scene with Southwestern architecture, desert cactus, and mountains. - A decorated Christmas tree in the center. - Place the original SlotTrak logo at the top of the Christmas tree instead of a traditional star. - Use navy blue and green brand colors for the tree decorations and lights. - Place the original Volante logo prominently on the navy blue base of the snow globe. **Background:** A beautiful winter atmosphere with subtle snowfall, delicate snowflakes, soft lighting, and tasteful Christmas decorations. **Typography:** The greeting must say only “Happy Holidays”. **Design Style:** Clean, elegant, realistic, modern, and professionally art-directed. The design should look like it was carefully crafted by an experienced human graphic designer, not like generic AI artwork. Avoid excessive 3D effects, artificial lighting, cartoon elements, and clutter. **Important:** Use the supplied original logos without altering their proportions or colors. Keep the snow globe as the main focal point. **Final Deliverables:** High-resolution PNG and print-ready PDF, 5.50 × 7.50 inches, 300 DPI, CMYK, with printer-approved bleed settings.

opportunities.title: AT&T FTTH Drafting Final Drawings
opportunities.description: Field data and red-lined sketches from our recent fiber-to-the-home walkout are ready; what I need now are the polished AT&T-compliant plans that turn those notes into construction-ready drawings. The scope is limited to fiber network drafting only—specifically FTTH distribution plans—so outside plant routes, splice cases, slack loops, terminals, and drop locations must all be shown exactly as captured in the field. I will forward the service area KMZ, hand-marked PDFs, pictures of each proposed placement, and the standard AT&T drafting guidelines. Your task is to translate this information into clean CAD files (DWG) and matching multipage PDFs that meet those guidelines on layers, symbology, title blocks, and sheet indexing. Where information is missing you can flag it, but please avoid guessing. Tools required: Waldo and Aramis for accurate drafting. Deliverables • AT&T-standard FTTH distribution drawings (DWG + PDF) • Updated legend, notes, and fiber counts per sheet • One revision cycle included to incorporate review comments Completion will be accepted once the files drop straight into AT&T’s permitting package without further edits. If you work in AutoCAD, MicroStation, or similar telecom drafting software and are comfortable with FTTH details, I’m ready to get started right away.

opportunities.title: Email Support Assistant Automation
opportunities.description: I’m launching a streamlined email help-desk and need reliable assistants who can take full ownership of the inbox. Your task is simple but vital: open every incoming message, draft a clear, friendly reply and hit “send” without waiting for managerial approval. The conversations you’ll handle break down into three familiar buckets—answering everyday product questions, sorting out order or account issues, and guiding customers through our services—so you should be comfortable switching between templated answers and personalised guidance. All communication stays inside the email channel; there’s no live-chat, phone or social feeds to monitor. You’ll receive a brand-voice guide, ready-made macros, and access to our help-desk platform (Zendesk, Freshdesk or similar). Escalation paths are documented for anything outside scope, but I count on you to resolve the majority of tickets independently. Deliverables • Inbox covered during the agreed schedule • 100 % of eligible tickets answered autonomously in real time • Brief daily report listing volumes handled, common issues, and any escalations If you’re fluent in written English, comfortable with email automation triggers, and eager to keep response times low, this will suit you perfectly. Let me know the hours you can reliably cover and which help-desk tools you prefer.

opportunities.title: Solana Multi-Wallet Trading Bot
opportunities.description: I need a custom trading bot that runs on the Solana network and can manage several of my wallets at once. Every time the bot opens or closes a position it must split that trade across the wallets according to percentages I set in a simple config file. Core trading logic The engine has to support all of the following rules: • Buy and sell at set price targets • Buy and sell based on indicators such as volume or price movement • Buy new tokens automatically and sell when profit or loss limits are reached Key expectations – Connect to each wallet through standard Solana RPC endpoints and sign transactions automatically. – Allow me to define the percentage allocation per wallet and change it without restarting the program. – Pull real-time market data (DEX order books, on-chain volume, price feeds) so the indicator-based logic reacts instantly. – Log every order with timestamp, wallet, size, and outcome to a local file or database for later analysis. – Provide clear, commented code; I prefer TypeScript with @solana/web3.js or Python with solana-py, but I’m open to your recommendation if it keeps latency low. Deliverables 1. Fully functional bot script/container 2. Configuration template showing wallet splits and rule parameters 3. Brief setup guide and usage instructions 4. One live demo trade on Devnet or with a small Mainnet amount to prove everything works If this is within your wheelhouse, tell me which language you would use, how you plan to implement the wallet splitting logic, and roughly how long you expect the build to take.

opportunities.title: Telugu Kids Cartoon Content Creation
opportunities.description: I run a small but fast-growing YouTube channel in Telugu and want to hand over the creative workload to someone who can take my raw ideas and turn them into polished, toddler-friendly cartoon episodes. The primary content is moral kids’ cartoons for the 2- to 4-year-old age group. Alongside those full-length videos, I regularly cut them down into YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, add bright Telugu captions, and design eye-catching thumbnails that look great on mobile. Here’s what I need from you on an ongoing basis: • AI-assisted cartoon video production (storyboarding, character creation, voice syncing, basic sound FX, background music). • Smooth, colorful edits that hold a toddler’s attention while keeping the moral message clear. • Short-form versions optimised for vertical viewing (15–60 sec). • Telugu on-screen text and accurate subtitles. • A high-impact thumbnail for every upload. Please share: 1. A few links to similar cartoon or children’s content you’ve produced. 2. Your typical turnaround time and pricing structure (per minute of finished video or per project—whatever works best for you). 3. Any AI tools or animation software you like to use (e.g., Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, etc.). I’m ready to start immediately and prefer collaborators who can commit to a consistent release schedule. Looking forward to seeing your work!

opportunities.title: Testers en Colombia · Desde tu celular · USD 50 por prueba completada
opportunities.description: Testers en Colombia · Desde tu celular · USD 50 por prueba completada Hola. En Puli AI ayudamos a que las apps financieras funcionen mejor para personas reales. Buscamos una persona en Colombia para probar apps de empresas financieras líderes (incluidas algunas que cotizan en bolsa), con su propia cuenta. En cada prueba se usa la app que asignemos. Qué vas a hacer Esto es más que opinar sobre una app: 1. Te registras una vez en cada app que te asignemos y completas su verificación de identidad con tus propios documentos. Esto pasa dentro de la app: Puli nunca ve tus documentos. 2. Haces el depósito mínimo que pide la app con tu propia tarjeta Visa o Mastercard, crédito o débito. Ese dinero vuelve a la misma tarjeta cuando lo retiras, y te reembolsamos todas las comisiones y costos por cambio de moneda. 3. Retiras ese dinero a la misma tarjeta. 4. Después de cada paso nos escribes por correo qué pasó, con pantallazos donde los datos privados estén tapados. Te enseñamos cómo. Tiempo: te decimos la duración estimada antes de cada prueba. La primera prueba en cada app toma más porque incluye el registro y la verificación. Es una misión de varias semanas, con al menos 2 pruebas por semana, en los horarios que te queden bien. Pago - USD 50 por cada prueba completada, en un plazo máximo de 7 días después de revisar tu prueba. El pago se hace en dólares (USD) a través de Freelancer.com. - Te reembolsamos todas las comisiones de tu tarjeta, las comisiones de la app y los costos por cambio de moneda, también a través de Freelancer.com y en el mismo plazo. El depósito vuelve a tu tarjeta según los tiempos de tu banco y de la app; normalmente unos días hábiles. - Si la prueba falla por un problema de la app, lo revisamos contigo caso por caso. - Trabajas como contratista independiente (prestación de servicios independiente), con un acuerdo de tester que firmas antes de tu primera prueba; tú te encargas de tus propios impuestos. No prometemos un ingreso fijo. Requisitos - Vivir en Colombia y tener un documento de identidad colombiano vigente - Tener 18 años o más - Tarjeta Visa o Mastercard (crédito o débito) de un banco colombiano, a tu nombre - Cualquier celular (iOS o Android) - Hablar español. Algo de inglés es un plus, pero no es obligatorio Tu privacidad Puli nunca te pide ni ve números de tarjeta, números de cuenta, saldos, contraseñas, códigos de verificación ni documentos de identidad. Para inscribirte solo necesitas tu nombre, correo, ciudad y tipo de celular. Puedes pedir que borremos tus datos cuando quieras: escríbenos por el chat de Freelancer.com y lo hacemos en un plazo de 48 horas. Para aplicar, envía tu propuesta aquí en Freelancer.com y cuéntanos tu ciudad y tu tipo de celular.

opportunities.title: Upgrade Ruang Belajar Pesantren
opportunities.description: Saya ingin memodernisasi fasilitas utama di pesantren kami—khususnya ruang belajar, perpustakaan, dan perlengkapan kelas—agar suasana belajar lebih kondusif serta mendukung metode pengajaran masa kini. Lingkup kerja yang saya butuhkan: • Audit singkat kondisi ruang belajar dan perpustakaan yang ada (bisa dilakukan lewat foto, video, atau survey jarak jauh). • Konsep desain renovasi: layout baru, penataan rak buku, area baca, dan alur sirkulasi yang efisien. • Spesifikasi perlengkapan kelas: meja-kursi ergonomis, papan tulis atau smart board, pencahayaan, serta solusi penyimpanan. • Rencana pengadaan dan estimasi anggaran material & furnitur—lengkap dengan alternatif low-cost namun tetap tahan lama. • Visual pendukung berupa denah 2D dan render 3D sederhana untuk mempermudah persetujuan pengurus. • Jadwal implementasi bertahap agar kegiatan belajar mengajar tetap berjalan selama proses peningkatan fasilitas. Keluaran akhir yang saya harapkan berupa paket dokumen digital (PDF + file editable) mencakup desain, daftar perlengkapan, dan rencana pelaksanaan. Saya terbuka bekerja jarak jauh selama komunikasi terjaga dan Anda mampu menyesuaikan desain dengan kearifan lokal pesantren. Jika Anda berpengalaman merancang ruang pendidikan, memahami ergonomi, serta mampu menyajikan solusi praktis untuk lingkungan pesantren, saya menantikan rancangan terbaik Anda.

opportunities.title: Local Personal Assistant Required in Hyderabad – 7-Day Project
opportunities.description: Local Personal Assistant Required in Hyderabad – 7-Day Project I am looking for a responsible, smart and proactive Personal Assistant based in Hyderabad to help me manage various tasks related to my small business, Homely Chocolates. I currently work full-time as a Software Engineer and manage my homemade chocolate business alongside my job. Due to my busy schedule, I need someone who can take ownership of assigned tasks, conduct local market research, explore suppliers and help me save time and money. This role requires someone who is comfortable visiting physical shops and wholesale markets in Hyderabad, comparing products and finding the best deals. Key Responsibilities 1. Local Market Research & Product Sourcing * Visit wholesale markets and local shops in Hyderabad. * Find affordable and good-quality chocolate compounds. * Source empty chocolate boxes, packaging boxes, gift boxes, baskets, ribbons and other packaging materials. * Explore different shops and compare prices. * Negotiate with vendors to get the best possible prices. * Share product pictures, shop locations, vendor contact details and quotations. * Identify reliable suppliers for future business requirements. 2. General Personal Assistance * Help with various tasks assigned during the project. * Research products, services and cost-effective solutions. * Explore new ideas and opportunities that can help my business. * Take initiative, suggest practical solutions and complete assigned tasks independently. Who Should Apply? * Must be based in Hyderabad. * Comfortable physically visiting local markets and shops. * Good communication and negotiation skills. * Responsible, trustworthy and organised. * Good at online research and using WhatsApp and Google Sheets. * Someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions. Project Duration & Compensation * Duration: Initial 7 days. * Fixed Payment: ₹2,000 for the complete project. * No separate travel allowance will be provided. * The personal assistant must manage their own commuting and other personal expenses. * Any business purchases must be approved by me in advance. Performance Bonus & Future Opportunity This is an initial one-week collaboration. I strongly believe in appreciating good work. If I am happy with your dedication, performance, initiative and the quality of your work, I will definitely provide an additional bonus/tip. There may also be an opportunity to continue working together beyond the initial seven days. I am not simply looking for someone to follow instructions. I am looking for someone dependable who can take responsibility, think independently and genuinely help me make my day-to-day work easier. If you are based in Hyderabad and interested in this opportunity, please apply!

opportunities.title: 60-Tonne Mobile Grain Bin
opportunities.description: I need a seasoned mechanical design engineer to turn my concept for a 60-tonne mobile grain storage bin into a complete, fabrication-ready package. Core requirements • Mobility: the unit must be designed to be towed safely behind a standard farm tractor or road-legal truck. • Product handled: wheat, barley and similar dry grains. • Unloading: integrate a gravity fed hydraulically driven auger able to discharge cleanly into trucks, seeders or other farm equipment. • Structure: heavy-duty welded steel, optimised for strength-to-weight and cost-effective manufacture in China. • Lift & safety: incorporate hydraulic lifting or stabilising mechanisms as needed for transport and operation, with all relevant structural calculations. Deliverables – Fully parametric 3D CAD model (SolidWorks, Inventor or similar) – Finite element analysis and hand-checked structural calculations showing compliance with 60-tonne payload – Hydraulic schematics, cylinder sizing and component list – Detailed manufacturing drawings and welding symbols to Chinese fabrication standards (metric) – Bill of materials with material grades, cut lengths and purchased parts – Brief assembly & maintenance guide for farm mechanics Keep the design practical, fabricate-able on standard CNC plasma, press-brake and MIG welding lines commonly found in Chinese steel shops. I’ll provide any extra dimensional constraints and compliance notes once we start; you’ll guide me on checks or data you still need. If you have a solid track record in agricultural machinery, structural steel and hydraulic systems, I’d like to see examples of similar work and hear how you would tackle this project from concept through to shop drawings.

opportunities.title: Commissioned Sales Partners (35%) Needed
opportunities.description: Are you good at finding clients, generating business opportunities, and closing deals? RS Orange Tech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for motivated Independent Freelance Sales Professionals and Lead Generation Partners to help us acquire new clients for our website development, mobile application, and custom software development services. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who have sales experience, strong communication skills, and the ability to independently generate genuine business leads. What We Offer 35% Commission on every successfully closed project. Attractive earning potential with no income ceiling. 100% remote collaboration – work from anywhere. Flexible working hours – no fixed schedule. No investment or registration fees. No sales targets or monthly commitments. Long-term business partnership opportunities. Technical consultation, project estimation, and development support from our team. Your Responsibilities As our Freelance Sales & Lead Generation Partner, you will: Independently identify and generate potential client leads. Find businesses, startups, entrepreneurs, and organizations looking for digital solutions. Reach out to potential clients through LinkedIn, email, phone calls, social media, networking, and other channels. Understand client requirements and introduce our services. Coordinate with our team for project discussions and quotations. Follow up with prospective clients and help convert opportunities into successful projects. Important Partnership Terms Please read the following conditions carefully: This is a commission-based independent partnership, not a salaried employment opportunity. You must independently generate your own leads and bring potential clients. RS Orange Tech will not provide ready-made leads, client databases, or prospect lists. The commission is 35% of the agreed eligible project value, subject to the agreed commercial terms. Commission becomes payable only after the client successfully pays the corresponding project amount to RS Orange Tech. For milestone-based projects, commission will be calculated and paid proportionately as eligible client payments are received. No fixed salary, joining bonus, advance commission, or upfront payment is offered. We are specifically looking for sales and client acquisition partners, not developers, programmers, or agencies offering development services. Our Services Our team provides a wide range of digital development services: Website Development: Business websites, corporate websites, eCommerce stores, and custom websites. Web Application Development: Custom web portals, SaaS platforms, CRM, ERP, and business management systems. Mobile App Development: Android applications and cross-platform mobile solutions. Custom Software Development: Tailor-made business applications and automation solutions. Technology Solutions: PHP, Laravel, Node.js, React, Next.js, Python, MySQL, and other modern technologies. Commission Payment Terms: - A 35% commission will be paid to the sales partner only after RS Orange Tech receives the payment from the client. - For projects with milestone-based payments, commission will be released proportionately after each corresponding client payment is received. - No advance commission or payment will be made before receiving the client's payment. Who Should Apply? We welcome independent professionals with experience or interest in: Freelance Sales and Business Development. B2B Lead Generation. Client Acquisition and Business Networking. LinkedIn Prospecting and Cold Outreach. Digital Agency Sales. IT Services and Software Sales. Startup and Business Development Consulting. You don't need any technical development skills. Your primary responsibility is to find genuine business opportunities and connect potential clients with our team. Let's Build a Long-Term Partnership! If you have the ability to find genuine clients and bring website development or software development projects, we would love to work with you. Join RS Orange Tech as a Freelance Sales & Lead Generation Partner and earn 35% commission on successfully acquired projects. Interested? Send us a direct message with: Your sales or lead generation experience. Your preferred lead generation approach. Any previous experience in IT or digital services sales. RS Orange Tech Pvt. Ltd. Let's connect, collaborate, and grow together!

opportunities.title: Interactive Kids 3D Donation Experience
opportunities.description: We are looking for a developer or small team to build the software and 3D content for an interactive kids’ exhibit at an upcoming event in Oman. The experience A large wall-screen (6 m × 3 m) shows a playful, game-like 3D world with friendly characters in Omani outfit. Children stand in front of the screen. Their body movements and gestures (waving, jumping, raising arms, moving left and right) make the characters react in real time. Beside the wall sits a floor-standing kiosk screen for e-payment donations. When a donation succeeds, the 3D characters on the wall react with a special celebration or interaction. The goal is to encourage kids to donate in a fun, interactive way. What we provide All hardware at the event: wall-screen, kiosk, PC/media player, and camera/sensor. The payment gateway account and its API will be handled by us. Your 3D world will listen for a success payment message in order to trigger an event/animation. What you deliver Interactive wall application (Unity) Real-time body/gesture tracking from a camera. Support for multiple children at once (state the number you can reliably track). 3D digital content A themed 3D environment and 2-3 animated characters (rigged, with idle, reaction, and celebration animations). Gesture-triggered reactions and a distinct donation celebration sequence. Required skills / procedures Unity (C#) engine Computer vision, pose estimation, or gesture tracking 3D modeling, rigging, and animation (Blender or similar) Experience with children’s content Arabic and English UI text. All assets must be original or properly licensed for commercial and public use. Timeline Beta version Deadline: 20th of Dec 2026 Official version Deadline: 18th of Jan 2027 Final Delivery Deadline: 25th of Jan 2027 Event date: 1st of Feb 2027

opportunities.title: Tavole 2D lamiera Inventor
opportunities.description: Ho alcuni componenti semplici già modellati in Autodesk Inventor che devo portare rapidamente in officina. Mi occorre trasformarli in tavole 2D per CNC, taglio o lavorazione lamiera, complete di indicazioni di taglio, pieghe e fori. Cosa mi aspetto: • Per ogni parte fornisco il file Inventor (.ipt o .iam). • Mi consegni un disegno 2D in DWG AutoCAD modificabile, pronto da inviare al laser/piegatrice o alla lavorazione CNC. • Quote chiare, linee di piega ben evidenziate, diametri e posizioni fori; nessuna tolleranza avanzata richiesta. • Ogni tavola deve restare ordinata e leggibile in formato standard A3 o A4, a tua scelta. • Indica il prezzo unitario per singolo disegno: valuto il totale in base al numero di parti. Requisiti: – Precisione e pulizia nel layout. – Esperienza concreta con lamiera in AutoCAD e Inventor. – Lavoro manuale: non accetto ne offerte ne processi basati su AI o automazioni generative. Se hai domande tecniche scrivimi pure; invierò un primo file di prova prima di confermare il resto del pacchetto.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40827165, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 8 - 30.

opportunities.title: Diseño de Logo y Sticker con Identidad Única para Marca de Granizados
opportunities.description: Se busca un diseñador gráfico talentoso para crear un logo distintivo y un diseño de sticker complementario para una nueva marca de granizados. El objetivo es desarrollar una identidad visual que se destaque, evite lo genérico y transmita una "vibra" específica, que puede ser fresca, divertida, moderna o refrescante, según la propuesta creativa. El proyecto incluye la creación del logo principal y un diseño de sticker versátil para aplicar en envases o promociones. Se valorará la originalidad y la capacidad de capturar la esencia de la marca en un diseño memorable. Se espera un portafolio que demuestre experiencia en branding y diseño de logos con personalidad. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Diseño de Logo ¿Qué necesitas?: Crear un logo desde cero

El personaje debe contar una pequeña historia: moverse con naturalidad, gesticular de forma expresiva y, si es posible, sincronizar labios con mi locución (te entregaré el audio definitivo). Lo que necesito de ti: • Diseño o adaptación del modelado (cartoon). • Rig completo con controles faciales y corporales listos para animar. • Animación final de aproximadamente 30-45 s que narre la historia de forma clara y entretenida. • Iluminación y render en formato cuadrado 1080×1080 (MP4), además de los archivos fuente del proyecto (Blender, Maya o herramienta similar). Aprecio sugerencias sobre guion, timing y acting para que el resultado sea dinámico y capte la atención desde los primeros segundos. Entregaré referencias visuales y la pista de audio tan pronto iniciemos. Si tienes ejemplos previos de personajes cartoon animados para Instagram, TikTok o YouTube Shorts, compártelos para ver tu estilo. Estoy listo para comenzar en cuanto definamos la duración exacta y el flujo de trabajo.

opportunities.title: Online product - Full-Service Marketing Boost
opportunities.description: My online store is generating steady traffic, but conversions are lagging behind. I want you to step in and manage every aspect of promotion—from the first social post to the final follow-up email—so that the store sees a measurable lift in customer enquiries and sales. Scope • Social platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok): plan and schedule engaging posts, reels, stories, and paid boosts that grow authentic followers while driving clicks to the storefront. • Google search & online ads: research keywords, build campaigns, optimise bids, and track ROI. • Email, WhatsApp, and other follow-ups: write persuasive sequences, segment the list, automate reminders, and keep the conversation going until the sale closes. What success looks like • A clear monthly content and ad calendar delivered in advance. • Conversion-focused creatives and copy that reflect our brand’s tone. • Regular reporting that shows reach, click-throughs, and, most importantly, sales generated. • Ongoing optimisation based on data, not guesswork. Tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Klaviyo/Mailchimp (or your preferred ESP), and basic design software will likely be needed; feel free to recommend alternatives you excel in. If you can treat this as a full-service engagement—owning strategy, execution, and performance tracking—let’s talk.

opportunities.title: EXPERIENCED B2B Email Contact Enrichment Specialist Needed
opportunities.description: Job Title: Experienced B2B Email Contact Enrichment Specialist — Paid Tools Required — Long-Term We are seeking an experienced Email contact enrichment specialist for an ongoing U.S. infrastructure research program. This role starts with researched contact records supplied by our team. Your responsibility is to match the correct person and employer, obtain missing individual business emails and direct business phone numbers, verify and document results, and return clean, organized data. We are looking for someone who already performs this work regularly and can demonstrate the process. MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS — READ BEFORE APPLYING You must have: • Current, authorized PAID access to Apollo.io, Hunter.io, and FullEnrich. Free accounts, trials, and plans to subscribe after being hired do not meet this requirement. • Demonstrated experience enriching lists supplied by clients. • Experience matching people accurately using names, employers, company domains, titles, and LinkedIn profiles. • Experience distinguishing individual business emails from generic company addresses. • Experience distinguishing direct business phone numbers from company switchboards. • Experience with email verification, duplicate control, and Excel/CSV delivery. • Experience processing batches through APIs or bulk enrichment tools, with usage tracking and spending controls. Python automation is an advantage. You must explain any automation you actually use. YOUR ASSIGNMENT Our researchers will provide records that may include: • Contact name and job title. • Employer and company website. • LinkedIn profile or other supporting source. • Assigned data center or contractor. • Project address and research notes. • Existing contact information. • A unique record ID and researcher/source attribution. You will: 1. Review the supplied records for missing information, identity conflicts, and duplicates before using paid credits. 2. Match each record to the correct person and current employer. 3. Find missing individual business emails and available direct business phone numbers. 4. Use additional approved sources when the first source does not produce an acceptable result. 5. Record the source, verification result, and date for each returned email. 6. Label phone numbers accurately as direct, mobile, main company, or unconfirmed. 7. Flag unresolved records and explain what prevented completion. 8. Preserve all original record IDs, project details, and researcher attribution. 9. Return a completed spreadsheet and a concise batch summary covering results, unresolved records, time spent, and credit usage. QUALITY RULES — NON-NEGOTIABLE • Never invent contact information or present an unverified email pattern as a verified address. • Never substitute a different employee merely to fill a missing record. • Never label a main company number as a direct phone. • Never treat an email verification result as proof that the email belongs to the correct person. • Clearly distinguish valid, invalid, catch-all, unknown, and unverified results. • Do not count generic addresses such as info@ or sales@ as completed individual email enrichment. • Do not claim that enrichment confirms someone’s responsibility for a particular construction project. • Flag conflicting employers, outdated titles, and uncertain identity matches. • Do not spend credits repeatedly on duplicate records without approval. • Do not remove, overwrite, or change supplied research information without documenting the proposed correction. • Do not contact the people on our lists or send campaigns. • No purchases, subscription changes, additional API spending, or work beyond the approved batch without written authorization. All emails intended for outreach will undergo our separate Clearout review. Your verification results must remain visible in the delivered file. REQUIRED APPLICATION FORMAT Begin your response with this exact sentence: “I enrich client-supplied email contact records and can demonstrate my paid tools, identity matching, verification, and credit controls.” Then answer the following questions in numbered order: 1. How long have you personally performed B2B contact enrichment, and what was your role in your most recent comparable project? 2. State your current paid plan for Apollo.io, Hunter.io, and FullEnrich. Identify whether access is through your own account or an authorized team account. 3. Can you demonstrate your current paid access and relevant features by screen share? YES / NO. Do not send passwords or API keys. 4. Describe your exact process when given a person’s name, employer, title, and company website—but no email or phone. 5. How do you avoid selecting the wrong person when names are similar or someone has changed employers? 6. How do you handle catch-all emails, conflicting results between providers, and phone numbers whose directness is uncertain? 7. How do you check duplicates before spending credits and record credit usage for each batch? 8. Which steps do you perform through bulk tools, APIs, or Python? Describe your own hands-on experience. 9. Provide a redacted example of a previous enrichment delivery showing the input fields, added contact information, sources, verification statuses, and unresolved records. Do not disclose another client’s confidential data. 10. Are you willing to complete a small, clearly defined qualification test under terms agreed in advance? YES / NO. SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted candidates must demonstrate their workflow and complete an agreed qualification test using records we supply. We will evaluate: • Correct identity and employer matching. • Usable individual business email coverage. • Accurate phone classification. • Clear handling of uncertainty and missing information. • Duplicate prevention. • Traceable sources and verification results. • Efficient use of credits and time. • Ability to follow instructions. Applications consisting only of general lead-generation claims, software lists, or promises of “100% accurate data” will not qualify. This is a potential long-term role for a dependable specialist who can consistently deliver accurate, usable contact information. Ongoing assignments will depend on demonstrated performance.

raw_data.verbatim_request: "Job Title: Experienced B2B Email Contact Enrichment Specialist — Paid Tools Required — Long-Term We are seeking an experienced Email contact enrichment specialist for an ongoing U.S. infrastructure research program. This role starts with researched contact records supplied by our team. Your responsibility is to match the correct person and employer, obtain missing individual business emails and direct business phone numbers, verify and document results, and return clean, organized data. We are looking for someone who already performs this work regularly and can demonstrate the process. MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS — READ BEFORE APPLYING You must have: • Current, authorized PAID access to Apollo.io, Hunter.io, and FullEnrich. Free accounts, trials, and plans to subscribe after being hired do not meet this requirement. • Demonstrated experience enriching lists supplied by clients. • Experience matching people accurately using names, employers, company domains, titles, and LinkedIn profiles. • Experience distinguishing individual business emails from generic company addresses. • Experience distinguishing direct business phone numbers from company switchboards. • Experience with email verification, duplicate control, and Excel/CSV delivery. • Experience processing batches through APIs or bulk enrichment tools, with usage tracking and spending controls. Python automation is an advantage. You must explain any automation you actually use. YOUR ASSIGNMENT Our researchers will provide records that may include: • Contact name and job title. • Employer and company website. • LinkedIn profile or other supporting source. • Assigned data center or contractor. • Project address and research notes. • Existing contact information. • A unique record ID and researcher/source attribution. You will: 1. Review the supplied records for missing information, identity conflicts, and duplicates before using paid credits. 2. Match each record to the correct person and current employer. 3. Find missing individual business emails and available direct business phone numbers. 4. Use additional approved sources when the first source does not produce an acceptable result. 5. Record the source, verification result, and date for each returned email. 6. Label phone numbers accurately as direct, mobile, main company, or unconfirmed. 7. Flag unresolved records and explain what prevented completion. 8. Preserve all original record IDs, project details, and researcher attribution. 9. Return a completed spreadsheet and a concise batch summary covering results, unresolved records, time spent, and credit usage. QUALITY RULES — NON-NEGOTIABLE • Never invent contact information or present an unverified email pattern as a verified address. • Never substitute a different employee merely to fill a missing record. • Never label a main company number as a direct phone. • Never treat an email verification result as proof that the email belongs to the correct person. • Clearly distinguish valid, invalid, catch-all, unknown, and unverified results. • Do not count generic addresses such as info@ or sales@ as completed individual email enrichment. • Do not claim that enrichment confirms someone’s responsibility for a particular construction project. • Flag conflicting employers, outdated titles, and uncertain identity matches. • Do not spend credits repeatedly on duplicate records without approval. • Do not remove, overwrite, or change supplied research information without documenting the proposed correction. • Do not contact the people on our lists or send campaigns. • No purchases, subscription changes, additional API spending, or work beyond the approved batch without written authorization. All emails intended for outreach will undergo our separate Clearout review. Your verification results must remain visible in the delivered file. REQUIRED APPLICATION FORMAT Begin your response with this exact sentence: “I enrich client-supplied email contact records and can demonstrate my paid tools, identity matching, verification, and credit controls.” Then answer the following questions in numbered order: 1. How long have you personally performed B2B contact enrichment, and what was your role in your most recent comparable project? 2. State your current paid plan for Apollo.io, Hunter.io, and FullEnrich. Identify whether access is through your own account or an authorized team account. 3. Can you demonstrate your current paid access and relevant features by screen share? YES / NO. Do not send passwords or API keys. 4. Describe your exact process when given a person’s name, employer, title, and company website—but no email or phone. 5. How do you avoid selecting the wrong person when names are similar or someone has changed employers? 6. How do you handle catch-all emails, conflicting results between providers, and phone numbers whose directness is uncertain? 7. How do you check duplicates before spending credits and record credit usage for each batch? 8. Which steps do you perform through bulk tools, APIs, or Python? Describe your own hands-on experience. 9. Provide a redacted example of a previous enrichment delivery showing the input fields, added contact information, sources, verification statuses, and unresolved records. Do not disclose another client’s confidential data. 10. Are you willing to complete a small, clearly defined qualification test under terms agreed in advance? YES / NO. SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted candidates must demonstrate their workflow and complete an agreed qualification test using records we supply. We will evaluate: • Correct identity and employer matching. • Usable individual business email coverage. • Accurate phone classification. • Clear handling of uncertainty and missing information. • Duplicate prevention. • Traceable sources and verification results. • Efficient use of credits and time. • Ability to follow instructions. Applications consisting only of general lead-generation claims, software lists, or promises of “100% accurate data” will not qualify. This is a potential long-term role for a dependable specialist who can consistently deliver accurate, usable contact information. Ongoing assignments will depend on demonstrated performance."

opportunities.title: Video Promotion - Naked Tuth
opportunities.description: In brief A 12-second vertical video (minimum 10s, maximum 15s) designed to spark interest in "Naked Truth"—a multiplayer Truth or Dare-style game played on smartphones (available at nakedtruth.fun). The primary edit is in a 9:16 aspect ratio, adapted for TikTok, Facebook (Reels), YouTube Shorts, and WhatsApp Status. • Objective: To get the viewer to click the link and start the free demo. • Core concept: Friends, each using their own phone; a card flips over; reactions ensue—"Truth or Dare, phone-style." • Target audience: Adults aged 18–35 who host social gatherings with friends or partners. • Language: The primary edit is in French. English and Spanish versions will use the same footage (with only the on-screen text translated). Storyboard (12s) The hook comes first: within the first 2 seconds, the viewer must understand that this is a party game. No single shot should exceed 3 seconds. Time Visual On-screen text Audio 0:00–0:02 Dark purple background. A glowing card flips over and fills the screen. "TRUTH or DARE?" (large, centered) Sharp bass hit as the card flips 0:02–0:05 3 or 4 friends on a sofa, each with their own phone. Close-up shots: an outburst of laughter, a hand covering a mouth, someone saying, "No, not me!" "Everyone on their own phone" Music builds, authentic laughter 0:05–0:09 Screen recording of the game (see provided files): sharing the room code, players joining, the wheel spinning, a card appearing. Fast-paced editing, cuts synced to the rhythm. "A code. "Everyone’s playing." A subtle sound effect at each cut 0:09–0:11 A scrolling banner showing the "vibes": Fun, Soft, Hot. Uses the site’s color palette; no suggestive imagery. "From family-friendly to spicy" Music at full volume 0:11–0:12 End screen: logo, URL, "Try for free" button. Keep as a clear, static image for 1.5 seconds. "nakedtruth.fun · Free demo" + "18+ for 'Hot' levels" (in small print) Complete silence on the final frame The 0:09–0:11 segment may be trimmed if the total edit exceeds 13 seconds; never cut the hook or the end screen. Optional voiceover variant: "Truth… or dare? Everyone grabs their phone, enters a code, and the night begins. Try it for free at nakedtruth.fun." Approximately 9 seconds at a natural pace. Technical Specifications A single master edit, exported with the same settings for all platforms (with the exception of file size for WhatsApp). Setting Required Value Format Vertical 9:16, 1080 × 1920 px Frame rate 30 fps (or 60 fps if screen captures are fluid) Duration Target 12 seconds; must be between 10 and 15 seconds File type MP4, H.264, AAC stereo audio File size Maximum 50 MB WhatsApp version: 16 MB maximum. Safe zones: Avoid placing important text within 250 px from the bottom, 150 px from the top, or 120 px from the right; these areas may be covered by platform-specific buttons or UI elements. Subtitles: Embedded in the video and large (most people watch without sound). Looping: The final frame must transition seamlessly into the first frame. Deliverables: One version per platform (TikTok, Facebook/Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, WhatsApp Status). If the budget allows, provide versions in French, English, and Spanish. Only the on-screen text changes between versions; the working file must keep text on separate layers so the client can edit it. Safe zones and file size limits are standard guidelines; the editor should verify these against the official templates for each platform before the final export. Brand, tone, and content guidelines: Tone: Engaging, humorous, and fast-paced. The goal is to elicit genuine laughter, not awkwardness. The viewer should think, "I want to try this with my friends." Brand colors: Usage Code Dark background #0D0A13 Brand purple #B03FE8 Fun (yellow) #F2AE3D Soft (green) #3DD9A0 Hot (pink) #FF4C86 Light text #F3EEF9 Font: Use the font from the website (the client will provide the file or the exact name). Visual style: Dark background, purple glow, flipping cards, rounded corners. Content guidelines (essential for platform approval): • The game includes levels restricted to users aged 18 and older. The promotional video must be suitable for all audiences: no nudity, no suggestive gestures or attire, and no sexually explicit questions displayed on screen. • All actors must be over 18 years of age (with a signed image release form for each, or footage sourced from a stock library with a commercial license). • Only the "Fun," "Soft," and "Hot" levels may be shown—indicated by their names and colors—without ever displaying the text from the more explicit cards. • The end screen must clearly state "18+ for 'Hot' levels." • The video must not contain any specific numerical promises or mentions of pricing. Music: Must be a royalty-free track with a commercial license (covering paid advertising), with a tempo of approximately 120–128 beats per minute. The editor must provide proof of the license. No commercially released (mainstream) music, even if "trending," is permitted.

"nakedtruth.fun · Free demo" + "18+ for 'Hot' levels" (in small print) Complete silence on the final frame The 0:09–0:11 segment may be trimmed if the total edit exceeds 13 seconds; never cut the hook or the end screen. opportunities.title: Multi-Channel AI Support Automation
opportunities.description: I’m ready to automate first-line support across three fronts—website live chat, our main email inbox, and WhatsApp—using n8n plus an AI model (OpenAI, GPT-4, or a comparable LLM). The goal is simple: when a customer message arrives, the workflow should instantly consult our existing help content—drawn from past support emails and chat transcripts—and send an accurate, friendly reply to the user. No ticket creation or hand-offs at this stage; the focus is quick answers that deflect the repetitive questions we handle every day. Here’s the flow I have in mind: • Inbound message lands on any of the three channels. • n8n triggers, cleans up the text, and feeds it to the AI with the relevant context snippets pulled from our historical conversations. • The AI crafts a concise response and posts it straight back to the same channel. • All exchanges are logged in a single place for later review and fine-tuning. Deliverables I’ll review for acceptance: 1. Three working n8n workflows—one each for live chat, email (IMAP/SMTP), and WhatsApp (Twilio or similar). 2. A reusable prompt/knowledge-retrieval setup that anchors the AI’s answers to my past support data. 3. Clear environment notes so I can rebuild or extend the flows myself. 4. A short video or screenshare walkthrough proving each channel responds correctly. If you’ve built conversational automations in n8n and can wrangle embeddings, vector stores, or other retrieval techniques to ground the AI’s answers, I’d love to see it in action.

opportunities.title: House Plumbing & Electrical Plans
opportunities.description: I’m finalizing the design of a new-build house and now need a complete, coordinated set of plumbing and electrical drawings. The architectural layout is ready in DWG and PDF; what’s missing are clear, construction-ready plans that my GC and the local inspector can approve without back-and-forth. Scope of work • Plumbing: supply and drainage layouts for every level, pipe sizing and materials, fixture legend, riser diagram, and notes for rough-in heights. • Electrical: lighting and power plans, circuiting, panel schedules, switching logic, load calculations, and a simple single-line diagram. File requirements 1. Editable CAD (AutoCAD or Revit) for each discipline. 2. Print-ready PDFs layered and titled clearly. 3. A brief coordination summary highlighting any clashes or special installation considerations. I’ll provide the floor plans, fixture/appliance list, and any manufacturer cut sheets you need. Please let me know your expected turnaround and how many revision cycles are included so we can keep the build on schedule.

opportunities.title: n8n Telegram AI Chatbot Build
opportunities.description: I need an experienced n8n automation expert to create an AI-powered Telegram bot that answers my users’ common questions. The workflow must rely on the OpenAI / ChatGPT API and draw its replies from the curated list of Q-and-A pairs I will supply. When a message arrives, the bot should recognise intent, fetch or generate the best matching answer, and send it back instantly through Telegram. You will be responsible for wiring up every step inside n8n: Telegram webhooks, prompt construction, OpenAI calls, error handling, basic logging, and an easy way for me to add or edit questions later. The finished workflow should be clean, well-commented, and exportable so I can import it into my own n8n instance without extra tweaking. Deliverables • Complete n8n workflow file (.json) ready to import • Brief README or screen-recorded walkthrough explaining node logic, environment variables, and how to update the Q-and-A set • Quick guide on obtaining and plugging in Telegram and OpenAI credentials Please share links to any previous n8n chatbots you have built (portfolio, repos, or short demo videos), give me an estimated turnaround time, and quote the total cost for the whole package. I’m looking for someone reliable who can move fast once we agree on details.

opportunities.title: Update Unit 1 Lift Drawings
opportunities.description: I already hold complete PDF floor plans, elevations and sections for Unit 1; what I now need is a fresh set of coordinated drawings that clearly show the proposed lift shaft and car in its final position. These revised plans, elevations and at least one key section will be issued straight to contractors for pricing, so accuracy, clear dimensions and tidy annotation are essential. I will forward the existing PDFs as a starting point. Your task is to insert the new lift, adjust any penetrations through floors or roofs that follow, and reflect those changes consistently across every view. Use AutoCAD, Revit or another mainstream BIM/2D package—whatever lets you return both editable files and print-ready PDFs without delays. Because the contractors are already asking for numbers, I need the updated set as soon as possible; once I send the background files, I would like a first draft within a couple of days and a final issue shortly after we resolve comments. Deliverables • Updated floor plan indicating lift position, dimensions and structural openings • Matching external and internal elevations with call-outs to the lift shaft • At least one fully detailed section through the lift core • DWG (or RVT) plus layered PDF for each sheet I’ll be on hand with quick feedback, so we can turn this around fast.

opportunities.title: CREACIÓN DE 2 VIDEOS EDITABLES PARA PRIMERA COMUNIÓN (NIÑO Y NIÑA)
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un diseñador gráfico y audiovisual con experiencia en creación de invitaciones digitales animadas y videos para eventos religiosos. Somos una imprenta y empresa de diseños personalizados. Necesitamos desarrollar dos videos de Primera Comunión: uno para niño y otro para niña. **OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL** Crear dos videos elegantes, modernos y profesionales que funcionen como plantillas maestras editables. Estos videos serán utilizados comercialmente para ofrecerlos a nuestros clientes, por lo que necesitamos poder personalizarlos posteriormente sin depender del diseñador. ### 1. VIDEO PARA NIÑO - Temática: Primera Comunión. - Estilo elegante, moderno, delicado y religioso. - Colores: celeste, blanco, perla y dorado. - Elementos: cáliz, cruz, Biblia, paloma del Espíritu Santo, ángeles y detalles decorativos. - Animaciones profesionales y transiciones suaves. ### 2. VIDEO PARA NIÑA - Temática: Primera Comunión. - Estilo elegante, delicado, femenino y religioso. - Colores: rosado pastel, blanco, perla y dorado. - Elementos: flores, cáliz, cruz, Biblia, paloma del Espíritu Santo y detalles decorativos. - Animaciones delicadas y transiciones suaves. ### 3. REQUISITO FUNDAMENTAL: PLANTILLAS EDITABLES Este punto es indispensable para contratar el servicio. Necesitamos recibir los archivos originales y editables de ambos videos, preferentemente en Canva, CapCut, After Effects, Premiere Pro u otra plataforma que permita modificar fácilmente: - Nombre del niño o niña. - Fecha de la Primera Comunión. - Hora y lugar de la ceremonia. - Nombre de los padres y padrinos. - Fotografías del niño o niña. - Textos y frases religiosas. - Música, cuando corresponda. - Otros detalles personalizados. La edición debe ser sencilla, de modo que nuestro personal pueda modificar los datos de cada cliente y generar un nuevo video sin conocimientos avanzados de edición. **No buscamos solamente dos videos terminados en MP4. Buscamos dos plantillas maestras reutilizables y editables.** ### 4. ENTREGABLES 1. Video final de Primera Comunión para niño en MP4. 2. Video final de Primera Comunión para niña en MP4. 3. Plantilla maestra editable del video para niño. 4. Plantilla maestra editable del video para niña. 5. Archivos originales del proyecto y recursos utilizados. 6. Enlaces de edición o duplicación de las plantillas, si se trabaja con Canva. 7. Breve tutorial de cómo cambiar los datos y fotografías. ### 5. ESPECIFICACIONES - Formato vertical 1080 x 1920 píxeles (9:16), ideal para WhatsApp, Instagram y redes sociales. - Buena resolución y calidad profesional. - Animaciones fluidas. - Tipografías elegantes y legibles. - Música y recursos con licencia que permita su uso comercial. - Sin marcas de agua. ### 6. PERFIL DEL FREELANCER Buscamos una persona que tenga experiencia en: - Diseño de invitaciones digitales animadas. - Edición de videos para eventos. - Motion Graphics. - Canva, After Effects, Premiere Pro o CapCut. - Creación de plantillas editables y reutilizables. **IMPORTANTE:** Al presentar su propuesta, agradeceremos adjuntar trabajos anteriores, indicar qué programa utilizará y confirmar que entregará las plantillas originales editables, con los derechos necesarios para su personalización y uso comercial. Buscamos una relación de trabajo profesional y posiblemente nuevos proyectos de diseños para nuestra empresa.

opportunities.title: Automatización IA para WooCommerce SEO
opportunities.description: Desarrollo de automatización con IA para actualización masiva de productos WooCommerce (800+ productos) Buscamos un desarrollador especializado en inteligencia artificial y automatizaciones para crear un sistema que permita actualizar automáticamente más de 800 fichas de producto de nuestra tienda online WordPress + WooCommerce. Objetivo Queremos automatizar la incorporación de contenidos SEO proporcionados por nuestra agencia externa. Actualmente recibimos los textos, títulos y metadescripciones en una hoja de cálculo. Necesitamos un sistema que, utilizando IA, sea capaz de interpretar esos contenidos, maquetarlos correctamente y trasladarlos automáticamente a los productos correspondientes. Funcionamiento esperado El sistema recibirá un Excel con las siguientes columnas: * URL del producto. * Nuevo título del producto. * Meta título SEO (si corresponde). * Meta descripción SEO. * Texto SEO completo, incluyendo encabezados H1, H2 y H3. La automatización deberá: 1. Acceder al producto correspondiente mediante su URL. 2. Identificar correctamente el producto en WooCommerce. 3. Actualizar el título y los campos SEO correspondientes. 4. Procesar el texto mediante IA. 5. Generar una maquetación HTML limpia, profesional y visualmente atractiva. 6. Respetar estrictamente los H1, H2 y H3 proporcionados por la agencia. 7. Organizar los textos mediante párrafos, listas, tablas, negritas y bloques cuando corresponda. 8. Mantener los estilos y la estructura visual de nuestra plantilla actual.. Requisitos fundamentales * No modificar precios, SKU, referencias, atributos ni otros datos del producto. * No alterar la plantilla global de Elementor. * No modificar los productos publicados mientras se preparan las nuevas versiones. * Evitar duplicidades de contenido. * Registrar los productos procesados y los errores. * Permitir procesar productos por lotes. * Posibilidad de revisar el resultado antes de publicarlo. opportunities.title: AI YouTube Video Producer Needed
opportunities.description: We are seeking an experienced 3D Character Animator / AI Video Producer for our YouTube channel, Work Smarter AI, featuring Toby Kingsley, a three-dimensional, anthropomorphic British tiger host. IMPORTANT: We require high-quality 3D CHARACTER ANIMATION. This is NOT a 2D animation, cartoon, slideshow, motion graphics, or basic AI avatar project. Our character must have a convincing three-dimensional appearance, detailed fur, natural facial expressions, realistic body movements, and accurate lip-sync synchronized with our supplied narration. We provide: * Completed scripts * ElevenLabs voice narration * Toby Kingsley character reference images * B-roll footage * Background music * Detailed visual directions Your responsibilities: * Produce polished, cinematic 8–10-minute YouTube episodes. * Create high-quality 3D character animation of Toby Kingsley. * Maintain consistent character appearance across scenes and episodes. * Deliver accurate lip-sync, natural expressions, and convincing movements. * Seamlessly integrate animated character scenes with cinematic B-roll, music, and professional editing. * Maintain engaging pacing and visual storytelling throughout each episode. Toby appears in selected scenes, not throughout the entire episode. MANDATORY PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT Applicants must provide direct links to existing examples of 3D animated characters speaking with accurate lip-sync. We are specifically looking for demonstrated 3D character animation experience. Portfolios consisting primarily of 2D animation, graphic design, charts, slideshows, or motion graphics do not meet our requirements. AI-assisted animation techniques are welcome, provided the finished animation meets our visual quality standards. Production checkpoints: 1. Early lip-sync preview for approval. 2. Complete rough cut for review. 3. Final delivery after agreed revisions. No unpaid custom tests are required. Please include: * Direct links to relevant 3D character animation examples. * Your fixed price per completed 8–10-minute episode. * Estimated turnaround time. * The animation and editing tools you use. We are looking for a reliable, long-term production partner, with the potential for consistent episodes and ongoing work.

opportunities.title: Integrar Firebase en App Java
opportunities.description: Ya tengo todas las pantallas de mi aplicación móvil terminadas en Java; lo que resta es enlazarlas con Firebase para que la información fluya correctamente. Objetivo • Conectar la app a Firebase (Realtime Database o Firestore, según consideres mejor) y dejar configurada la autenticación básica que requiera la base de datos. Alcance concreto 1. Configurar el proyecto Android con los servicios de Firebase. 2. Implementar las operaciones CRUD para los datos de formularios, perfiles y publicaciones: – Crear y guardar nuevos registros. – Consultar y listar registros existentes. – Editar y eliminar registros propios del usuario. 3. Manejar estados de carga, errores y mensajes de confirmación dentro de las pantallas ya diseñadas. 4. Entregarme el código limpio y comentado, más una breve guía de cómo seguir agregando campos o colecciones si lo necesito. La aplicación está escrita íntegramente en Java (Android Studio). Valoraría buenas prácticas de arquitectura (por ejemplo, MVVM con ViewModel y LiveData) y el uso de librerías recomendadas por Google, pero si prefieres otra aproximación clara y ordenada, soy flexible. Busco alguien que pueda terminar la integración sin rehacer las vistas, explique sus cambios y, si es posible, realice una revisión rápida para asegurar que todo quede listo para publicar.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40826807, publicado hace 12 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: Migración y Sincronización Carbonio Productiva
opportunities.description: Actualmente, tengo un servidor con Carbonio 25.6.1 en producción (cerca de 1200 cuentas) que está integrado a Microsoft 365 con 90 cuentas de correo app. Tengo otro servidor, con Carbonio, versión 26.6.2, en que se dejó activa la capacidad de almacenamiento de las cuentas de correo (dado que según entiendo, esta versión no lo soporta), por ende, esa parte se dejó como la versión antigua. Actualmente, está semi migrada la información de ambos servidores. Requiero, Resincronizar la información de ambos servidores Traspasar las opciones de cada cuenta de correo (por ejemplo, fw, no dejar copia en la cuenta de correo, entre otros) Finalmente, dejar en producción el nuevo Dejar sincronizando diariamente el servidor principal con versión 26.6.2 a uno de respaldo, que tiene la versión 25.6.1 para casos de desastres. Eso en una primer etapa. Después, podríamos ver, crear otra máquina, con misma configuración de la máquina nueva (quizá con menos ram) y dejarla para que se haga respaldo diariamente de la principal, en vez de la que se usará para ello de momento, es decir, la 25.6.1). Nota que es importante, mantener la restricción de capacidad en cada cuenta de correo (de hecho, pensaba dejarlo como viene en la versión 25.6.2 y realizar un desarrollo aparte para poder controlar el tema de las capacidades -ya lo tengo evaluado-).

opportunities.title: LEGO-Compatible 3D Portrait Design
opportunities.description: I have a high-resolution photo that I want transformed into a buildable, LEGO-style wall portrait. The final display should sit comfortably on a medium-sized wall area—think several standard baseplates wide and tall—yet remain light enough to hang with ordinary picture hardware. Here is what I need from you: • A design that combines standard LEGO bricks with a small set of custom 3D-printed elements where standard pieces do not exist. The custom pieces should solve any colour, shape, or connection challenges that off-the-shelf bricks can’t handle while still locking to regular studs. • The model must be split into clearly numbered sections or panels so I can print, build, and transport it in manageable chunks, then click everything together for the final reveal. Model should be broken into multiple Lego sized pieces rather than less bigger pieces. • A complete building guide (PDF or Stud.io instructions) that walks through each step, plus a parts list that distinguishes between LEGO parts and the custom files I’ll need to print. Sample image attached. Real image will be supplied once job starts. Please keep stud alignment clean and avoid fragile half-stud offsets wherever possible. If you work in Stud.io, LDraw, Blender, or Fusion 360, just let me know which file formats you’ll deliver so I can open and review them. Once approved, I’ll take care of printing and brick sourcing on my end. If this sounds like your kind of project, I’m ready to share the reference image and get started right away.

opportunities.title: Branding Bilingüe Profesional para Restaurante
opportunities.description: Ya cuento con un logotipo, pero requiere un acabado profesional. Necesito que los textos en inglés y árabe se lean a la perfección, que los colores tengan más vitalidad y que tanto el icono como la composición general presenten un equilibrio adecuado, tanto para su uso en formato digital como impreso. Una vez perfeccionado el logotipo, necesitaré un conjunto completo de materiales de marca para mi restaurante. Es indispensable mantener la coherencia entre el inglés y el árabe en todos los elementos. Entregables: • Archivos del logotipo actualizados (en formato vectorial y para web) • Papelería: tarjetas de presentación, papel con membrete y sobres • Empaques: bolsas para llevar, cajas para alimentos y vasos • Elementos de atención al cliente: menús y recibos • Elementos para el personal: detalles de marca aplicados a uniformes Al presentar tu propuesta, por favor comparte tu experiencia relevante en proyectos de branding bilingüe (preferiblemente en árabe e inglés) o en el sector de la hostelería. Una vez que comencemos, te facilitaré el logotipo actual y la historia de la marca para avanzar rápidamente hacia la fase de desarrollo creativo y la presentación de pruebas.
